text:
maria: hey — running the Node quickstart sample and my first call to /v1/generate is returning 403. error body says \"billing_required\". followed the README steps though. anyone seen this?

sam: can you paste the curl or the code you're using?

maria: sure:

```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_xxx
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{\"error\":\"billing_required\",\"message\":\"Workspace payment method required\"}
```

sam: ok that's a billing_required response. are you part of an org workspace with billing enabled or did you sign up via an invite link?

maria: I joined from an invite link sent by a teammate. I logged in with Google and didn't add a payment method.

oliver: @maria that flow can be subtle — invited users sometimes remain in a \"trial pending\" state until the org owner completes billing. the API returns 403 in that case. the web UI should show a banner.

maria: also noticed the quickstart README uses a different env var name than the sample app. README says REDWOOD_TOKEN but sample uses REDWOOD_API_KEY. could that cause a 401 instead? I'm getting 403 though.

sam: env mismatch would be 401/invalid-key, not billing_required. so two DX issues: (1) docs/env var inconsistency, (2) quickstart doesn't surface billing gating or remediation.

devex-bot: Note: SDK retry policy retries on 5xx and network errors only. 4xx (401/403) are surfaced immediately. Filing follow-up to improve guidance for billing_required errors.

maria: quick unblock — can I create a personal workspace and test?

oliver: yes. go to https://console.redwood.ai/account/workspaces and create a personal workspace, add a payment method (trial may apply), or run:

```
redwood-cli workspaces create --name \"maria-personal\"
redwood-cli workspaces link --id wrk_12345
```

sam: or ask the org owner to enable billing or invite you with billing access.

maria: ran the CLI link and re-ran the curl. now:

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{\"output\":\"hello\"}
```

maria: works now :tada:

sam: filing two tickets: DX-3421 to fix README env var inconsistency, DX-3422 to enhance SDK error message for billing_required with a direct link to workspace billing + remediation steps.

devex-bot: Ticket created: DX-3421, DX-3422.

maria: leaving a note in the quickstart PR with repro steps. thanks! :thumbsup:
